profile.headline: Software Engineer Extraordinaire
profile.summary:
Graduated from the University of Utah in Spring 2013 in Computer Science with a Minor in Mathematics.

Currently working for SirsiDynix since 2013, as a Software Engineer. SirsiDynix creates software for all kinds of Libraries, from public Libraries to specialty Libraries, across the world.
  
When not at work, I'm working on hobby projects including various AutoPlayers. AutoPlayers mix Image Processing and Artificial Intelligence. They play computer based games with the same limitations humans have: 
  - They must interpret the screen visually
  - They then decide what action to take
  - Lastly, they must use the mouse and keyboard to perform those actions.
 
For instance, I have created AutoPlayers for games such as Bejeweled, RevolvoMan, and am currently working on an AutoPlayer for Plants vs. Zombies.

Visit my website at:

   www.TonyLitchfield.com

for a list and description of my projects, along with useful technical details about the whole process.

positions.title: Teacher's Assistant for Discrete Structures (CS-2100)
positions.description:
· 
• Assisted Professor Whitaker and the 89 students taking the class as one of three assistants.
· 
• Taught discussion sections every week, led exam review sessions every two weeks, held office hours, and performed grading. 
· 
• Explained Probability, Combinatorics, and Proofs in a simple, yet complete, manner.
